Context: 8. Dress Allowance

## 8. Dress Allowance  
With effect from 1-7-2017, Uniform Allowance and Washing.Allowanos have been subsumed in a single Dress Allowance as below.-  
1. Admissibility.Categories of staff who were supplied uniforms and are required to wear them regularly like Trackmen, Running Staff of Indian Railways, Staff Car Drivers, MTS, Canteen Staff of Non-Statutory Departmental Canteens, etc.
2. Rate.-~ 5,000 per year. The amount shall be credited to the-salary of employees directly once a year in the month of July.
